The shell fills the house interior with air (`shell.mjs:27`), so every cell of the entrance hall (x45..50, z43..60, y4..9) is already owned. No cell inside the room is free for furniture, so "move" has nowhere to go. The only compliant fix inside `room-1.mjs` is to remove the writes, so I'll do that and keep the layout data for when the shell stops claiming the room.

input.summary:
parts/room-1.mjs (entrance hall) now writes nothing: its furniture and hanging lanterns are commented out, with the layout kept as data and a note on why.
Cause: shell.mjs box() fills the whole house interior with air, and runParts locks every cell an earlier part wrote, air included, so no cell in x45..50 z43..60 y4..9 is free.
make.sh runs and its entrance-hall line reads "0 placed", with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for this part. The part is not built.
left: Entrance hall has no furniture: red runner, two console tables, settees, coat rack, standing and hanging lanterns are all removed for now. Restore by re-enabling the layers() calls and the chain/lantern loop in build() once the room's air is free.

Root cause is in parts/shell.mjs line 27 (box() fills x27..68, z43..60, y3..17 with air), which claims every room cell. The fix belongs in the shell or in runParts (treat air-only claims as not owned). This is outside room-1.mjs, so I did not touch it.

The same refusal hits other room parts, all inside the house interior: room 2 parlour library, room 3 dining, room 9 butler's pantry, room 10 powder room, room 12 kitchen, room 17 bedroom 3, room 22 bedroom 5, room 26 bedroom 6, and room 6 guest bedroom. Room 11 living room and the upper-floor room 13 do not show refusals in the make.sh output.

Outside the house, the refusals are not from the shell: the ground gallery's iron_chain (47,8..9,38), the cottage bath (85,2,73 and 85,5,72), the gazebo lanterns (11/15, 6, 79 and 83) and the greenhouse slab/fence/lantern cells at x5/x16, y1 come from other parts. Those are not in this part's scope.

make.sh still reports roof OFF-PALETTE blocks (tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_slab and others) from roof.json. That is the roof spec's problem, not this part's, and I did not change it.

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned each refused cell: I read runParts (build.mjs:191-243) and shell.mjs box() by hand to learn that air fills count as owned, rather than getting the owner from the refusal report.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and reading two modules, to explain 42 refusals that all share one cause
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts should name the owning part and its fill box for each refusal (e.g. 'owned by shell box 27..68,3..17,43..60 air'), and mcd plan should show owned cells per room, so a designer sees the lock before writing.

waste.what: Deciding that no free cell existed inside the room, so the writes could not be moved: I checked this by hand against the shell's air fill rather than with a query.
waste.cost: one reasoning pass over the room box x45..50 z43..60 y4..9 against shell box(26,42,69,61)
waste.tool: mcd plan <build.nbt> --rooms rooms.json --only 'entrance hall' should mark which room cells are free versus owned; that answers 'can this room hold furniture' in one call.

waste.what: Removing or commenting out 42 writes by hand instead of a tool that says which writes survive the lock.
waste.cost: one file edit and one make.sh rerun
waste.tool: a dry-run flag on runParts that reports per-part writes that would be refused, before the part is built.

companions.task: Build the console tables, dark-oak settees, coat rack and the red runner once the shell releases the entrance hall's air.
Hang the centre-line chain lanterns under the upper hall and set the standing lanterns on the lamp posts at the back corners.

structured_output.summary:
parts/room-1.mjs (entrance hall) now writes nothing: its furniture and hanging lanterns are commented out, with the layout kept as data and a note on why.
Cause: shell.mjs box() fills the whole house interior with air, and runParts locks every cell an earlier part wrote, air included, so no cell in x45..50 z43..60 y4..9 is free.
make.sh runs and its entrance-hall line reads "0 placed", with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for this part. The part is not built.
left: Entrance hall has no furniture: red runner, two console tables, settees, coat rack, standing and hanging lanterns are all removed for now. Restore by re-enabling the layers() calls and the chain/lantern loop in build() once the room's air is free.

Root cause is in parts/shell.mjs line 27 (box() fills x27..68, z43..60, y3..17 with air), which claims every room cell. The fix belongs in the shell or in runParts (treat air-only claims as not owned). This is outside room-1.mjs, so I did not touch it.

The same refusal hits other room parts, all inside the house interior: room 2 parlour library, room 3 dining, room 9 butler's pantry, room 10 powder room, room 12 kitchen, room 17 bedroom 3, room 22 bedroom 5, room 26 bedroom 6, and room 6 guest bedroom. Room 11 living room and the upper-floor room 13 do not show refusals in the make.sh output.

Outside the house, the refusals are not from the shell: the ground gallery's iron_chain (47,8..9,38), the cottage bath (85,2,73 and 85,5,72), the gazebo lanterns (11/15, 6, 79 and 83) and the greenhouse slab/fence/lantern cells at x5/x16, y1 come from other parts. Those are not in this part's scope.

make.sh still reports roof OFF-PALETTE blocks (tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_slab and others) from roof.json. That is the roof spec's problem, not this part's, and I did not change it.

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned each refused cell: I read runParts (build.mjs:191-243) and shell.mjs box() by hand to learn that air fills count as owned, rather than getting the owner from the refusal report.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and reading two modules, to explain 42 refusals that all share one cause
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts should name the owning part and its fill box for each refusal (e.g. 'owned by shell box 27..68,3..17,43..60 air'), and mcd plan should show owned cells per room, so a designer sees the lock before writing.

waste.what: Deciding that no free cell existed inside the room, so the writes could not be moved: I checked this by hand against the shell's air fill rather than with a query.
waste.cost: one reasoning pass over the room box x45..50 z43..60 y4..9 against shell box(26,42,69,61)
waste.tool: mcd plan <build.nbt> --rooms rooms.json --only 'entrance hall' should mark which room cells are free versus owned; that answers 'can this room hold furniture' in one call.

waste.what: Removing or commenting out 42 writes by hand instead of a tool that says which writes survive the lock.
waste.cost: one file edit and one make.sh rerun
waste.tool: a dry-run flag on runParts that reports per-part writes that would be refused, before the part is built.

companions.task: Build the console tables, dark-oak settees, coat rack and the red runner once the shell releases the entrance hall's air.
Hang the centre-line chain lanterns under the upper hall and set the standing lanterns on the lamp posts at the back corners.
